query: What's the idiomatic way to instrument Python functions with Langfuse?
expected_snippet: without polluting business logic

query: Why shouldn't I self-host Langfuse v3 on my local dev machine?
expected_snippet: will OOM your 8GB machine

query: Is it fine to call langfuse.flush() after every request in production?
expected_snippet: Blocks the response thread. Flush is for tests and scripts only.

query: Do I need a separate tokenizer library to count tokens from my local Ollama calls?
expected_snippet: You never need a separate tokenizer library for this lab

query: Why log LLM costs to my own Postgres table instead of relying only on Langfuse's UI?
expected_snippet: it doesn't disappear if you ever change observability vendors

query: Why does time-to-first-token scale with prompt length rather than output length?
expected_snippet: processing the entire input prompt through the network once, in parallel, before any generation starts

query: Why is average latency a misleading headline metric for an LLM pipeline?
expected_snippet: it doesn't tell you whether you have a slow retrieval step, a slow prefill, or a model that's just generating 400 tokens when 80 would do

query: How does Langfuse decide which prompt version to serve if I don't pass a label?
expected_snippet: resolves the `production` label by default

query: Does a non-significant result at n=50 per arm mean two prompt variants perform the same?
expected_snippet: we don't have enough data to be confident about the direction

query: Why won't a citation-rate monitor catch concept drift in a RAG system?
expected_snippet: This is squarely a document-freshness problem, not a prompt or model problem

query: Why do drift detectors need a minimum effect-size threshold in addition to a p-value?
expected_snippet: even a trivial, meaningless difference becomes

query: What's the example scenario used to simulate output quality drift in the lab?
expected_snippet: someone reverts the `production` label on your `rag-answer` prompt from v2 (citation instruction) back to v1 (baseline)

query: Why does the CI eval gate use an absolute pass-rate floor instead of a significance test?
expected_snippet: a significance test at n=12 would be unreliable

query: Why does the CI pipeline pull its own model instead of assuming one is already available?
expected_snippet: there's no Ollama instance sitting in GitHub's cloud waiting for you

query: Why is alerting on every individual slow request a bad idea?
expected_snippet: roughly 10% of all requests always sit above the P90 by construction

query: Which kinds of alerts should wait for business hours instead of paging someone immediately?
expected_snippet: Elevated latency, cost creep - degraded, not broken

query: Why can't the local drift-check script run as a scheduled GitHub Actions job?
expected_snippet: only works while YOUR machine + app are running

query: Can you fix poor HNSW recall just by raising efSearch at query time without rebuilding?
expected_snippet: this is the one you tune at runtime, per query, without rebuilding anything

query: Why doesn't Qdrant offer an IVF index option?
expected_snippet: Qdrant currently only uses HNSW as a dense vector index

query: Why do the benchmark's query vectors use a different random seed than the database vectors?
expected_snippet: if a query vector were identical to a database vector, its nearest neighbor would trivially be itself at zero distance, artificially inflating recall
